guitar.modelsText: Gibson Flying V / Harmony Meteor / Telecaster
guitar.notes: Dave Davies famously slashed his amp speaker for distortion using a Harmony/Telecaster-type setup; reasonably documented, medium confidence is fair.

tone.target: nasal early-fuzz rock crunch with raw mono bite
tone.profile: nasal early-fuzz rock crunch with raw mono bite
tone.summary: A high-gain fuzz signal chain utilizing a Fuzz distortion unit, followed by a Boost for bite, feeding into a classic UK combo amp model (UK 45) with a tight cabinet (UK Vintage 4x12).
